anthropic.required: The explicitly requested Anthropic API, Claude Design or official Claude CLI connection; never reuse subscription tokens as generic API credentials.

google-ai.required: Authorized Google AI capability for the requested text, image, speech or grounding action; current model availability must be discovered.

openai-api.required: Current native OpenAI capability or an explicitly authorized API connection. Native subscribed tools are not generic API billing credentials.

deepseek.required: Authorized DeepSeek text/reasoning capability and a currently supported model.

kimi.required: Authorized Moonshot/Kimi capability when that provider is explicitly requested; generic reasoning can run natively without claiming a Kimi call.

multi-model.required: Explicitly authorized independent evaluators/providers with a bounded manifest, current models, cost controls and observed outputs; no fabricated cross-model consensus.

google-workspace.required: The specific Google Workspace service connector and requested read/write scope for the user's selected account. One working Google connection does not prove every API is authorized.

google-cloud.required: Authorized Google Cloud project/bucket connection and exact storage operation; inspect IAM and destination before mutation.

google-analytics-ads.required: Authorized Ads, Analytics or Search Console connector for the selected account/property, with actual operation-specific scope.

microsoft-mail.required: Authorized native Microsoft mail connector; explicit desktop COM requests additionally require the user's local Outlook profile and supported Windows runtime.

mail-protocols.required: User-selected mailbox/server with approved IMAP read or SMTP send access, TLS and a secure credential mechanism; no default recipient/account.

deepgram.required: Authorized Deepgram transcription capability and permission to upload the selected audio; verify actual transcript, timings and speaker labels.

deepl.required: Authorized DeepL text/document translation connection and applicable account endpoint, glossary and language scope.

elevenlabs.required: Authorized ElevenLabs speech/audio capability and permission to use the selected voice; no baked-in voice identity.

d-id.required: Authorized D-ID presenter-generation capability, permitted portrait/audio and real job completion.

heygen.required: Authorized HeyGen avatar/video capability and permission for the chosen identity/voice.

gamma.required: Authorized Gamma generation/export capability. A local presentation is not proof of a Gamma operation.

manus.required: Authorized Manus task or slide-generation connection when the provider is explicit. Generic slides use native presentations without claiming Manus execution.

figma.required: Native Figma connection for actual file/frame reads, export or the requested supported write operation; API read access does not imply arbitrary canvas editing.

miro.required: Authorized Miro board connection with the exact requested read/write operation and selected board.

notebooklm.required: An available authorized NotebookLM capability or the user's normal interactive browser flow; no cookie extraction or private undocumented session API.

perplexity.required: Authorized Perplexity search/research capability when explicitly requested; generic research uses native web with sources.

serpapi.required: Authorized SerpAPI search capability with selected engine/locale and observed result metadata.

similarweb.required: Authorized Similarweb data access for the selected domain/period; do not fabricate unavailable traffic estimates.

apify.required: Authorized selected scraping/ad-library/intelligence capability, lawful target scope, bounded dataset/job and verified source timestamps.

maps.required: Available map/place/geocoding capability for the selected region and task; respect provider attribution/rate rules and verify live places.

pinecone.required: Authorized Pinecone index/namespace connection, embedding dimension/model compatibility and exact data-sharing scope.

n8n.required: User-selected n8n/automation instance and authorized connector. Validate a workflow against actual nodes/credentials before activation; raw sample exports were deliberately omitted.

social-publishing.required: An authorized connector for the exact platform/account and action, plus verified destination, visibility and readback. Do not silently switch publishing providers.

telegram.required: Authorized Telegram bot or user-account transport appropriate to the requested action, explicit destination and actual readback; no copied session file.

youtube.required: The specific YouTube transcript/analytics/upload capability. Public transcripts may not need account access; analytics/upload requires the selected authorized channel and action.

zoom.required: Authorized Zoom meeting/recording capability for the selected account and explicit operation; recording contents are private inputs.

twilio.required: Authorized Twilio account/sender and permitted recipient, exact message/cost authorization, and delivery status; credentials alone do not provision a sender.

yandex.required: The selected Yandex Disk/Metrika/mail/calendar capability. Public-link retrieval is separate from account OAuth or write access.

tilda-crm.required: Authorized selected Tilda project and CRM connection; read/rehearse before publishing or submitting real lead forms and verify end-to-end readback.

home-assistant.required: User-selected Home Assistant instance and explicit device/action authorization; reading state does not authorize physical control.

apple-developer.required: Authorized Apple Developer identity/certificates and supported signing/notarization runtime or approved CI; no certificates or signing keys are included.

deployment.required: Explicit deployment/registry/DNS/Git remote target, authorized credentials, rollback and real service verification; never infer a server from author-specific defaults.

task-manager.required: Authorized actual task/calendar connector for the selected account, or user-supplied exported tasks for local planning. Scheduling/sending requires exact intent.

specialized-local.required: The specifically requested local engine/application and its reviewed project-owned adapter. GPU/models, CAD COM, OCR/segmentation, transparency and local PII filtering are not supplied by a generic native image tool. Do not upload unfiltered data to compensate.

external-media.required: Authorized exact media provider and supported current operation/model, permitted inputs, cost boundary and completed output validation.

ai-detectors.required: Explicit authorization to share the text with selected detector providers; scores are detector observations, not proof of authorship.

course-submission.required: The user-selected course submission service and their authorized account. Never infer the destination from the pack author; submit only the explicit assignment/artifact and verify its actual status.
